Vonder Horst Bros. contracted for excavating, plumbing, riveting and painting on a ten-storey steel frame store and office building for the Schroth Company.
Selfridge & Sypher contracted for fireproofing, concrete, terra cotta and metal lathing on a ten-storey steel frame building for the Schroth Company.
Selfridge & Sypher contracted for bulkhead and concrete on a ten-storey steel frame building for the Schroth Company, at $3,600.
E. S. Curtis, an electric company and Mangrum & Otter contracted for plumbing, electric wiring and steam heating on a ten-storey building for the Schroth Company.
Franklin F. Ralston contracted for carpentry, glazing, lockers and galvanized iron trimming on a ten-storey building for the Schroth Company, at $28,350.
Otis Elevator Company contracted for two electric passenger and one hydraulic ram elevators on a building for the Schroth Company, at $8,061.
Knowles & Kaiser contracted for plastering and damp proofing on a ten-storey steel frame building for the Schroth company, at $9,000.

Columbia marble company, Mangrum & Otter, Vulcan iron works and H. Maundrell contracted for marble and tile, cast and wrought iron, painting and varnishing on a ten-storey building for the Schroth company, at $16,275.
